page.overview:
Who is Four Fiends?

The Four Fiends are the primary bosses in the original Final Fantasy, consisting of the lich of Earth, Marilith of Fire (Kary in the NES version), the kraken of Water, and Tiamat of Wind. The theme of four elemental demonic guardians carried over to some future installments in the series, hearkening back to the original four.

The Four Fiends were created 2000 years ago when Garland's hatred merged with the four elements of the world. The purpose of the Fiends would be to send Garland 2000 years into the past whenever he would be killed by the Warriors of Light. According to one of the Sky Warriors turned into a bat in the Chaos Shrine (who only speaks after defeating the Four Fiends), once Garland is sent to the past, his Fiends would send the power they drew from the four elements back to their master. Once he has absorbed enough power, Garland would send the fiends, whom he has created in the past, to the future where they drain from the four elements in the first place, thus creating a time loop in which he can live forever.

Four hundred years before the Warriors of Light appear in Cornelia, Tiamat destroyed the Sky People's civilization and made their Flying Fortress, home of the Wind Crystal, her roost. By draining the element of wind from the crystal, the wind stops blowing across the world. Two hundred years later, the kraken invaded and sunk the Sunken Shrine from the previous civilization of Onrac, home of the Water Crystal and later the mermaids. Draining the element of water causes the sea to become violent (likely causing the destruction of the previous civilization of Onrac) and causing no light to be shone underwater, threatening the lives of the mermaids.

The lich had begun to rot the land near Melmond from the Cavern of Earth where the Earth Crystal awaits restoration, and after the lich's defeat, Marilith awakes two hundred years early and takes up residence in Mount Gulg alongside the Fire Crystal. She is supposed to set the world on fire by the time she wakes up, but can also do so during the present time had she not been defeated the party.
